perturbation_sensitivity.disclaimer: Reported as empirical sensitivity metrics under matched +1% scaling; stability is not inferred to be proportional from aggregate means alone.

faithfulness.intervention_budget_note: Intervention sizes reset metrics to architectural nominal baselines (e.g. latency reset to 15-25ms vs backlog reset to 0 vs offered rate to nominal mean). Budgets are domain-scaled per telemetry channel rather than numerically identical.
faithfulness.experimental_nature: Model-sensitivity experiments under controlled physical group interventions; not verified physical causal effects. Top > Low alone does not constitute validated faithfulness.

suspected_origin_localization.production_dataset_note: Ground truth injected origin node labels are absent from degradation_dataset.json. Synthetic diagnostic fixture results do not demonstrate validated root-cause detection on production incidents.

diagnostic_fixture_benchmark.tie_handling_policy: Rankings use unrounded full-precision risk drops. Ties (< 1e-7) exclude cases from decisive Top-1. Top-3 membership evaluates if injected origin is in top 3 unrounded candidates; rank-3 boundary ties are monitored and reported.

representative_cases_evaluated.scenario: Case 1: Verified True Early Warning (TP - Sustained Degradation)
Case 2: Verified False Alarm (FP - Premature Alert Without Follow-Up Breach in Window)
Case 3: Verified Missed Event (FN - Sub-Threshold Risk Preceding Sustained Breach)
Case 4: Verified True Negative (TN - Stable Nominal Operation)
Case 5: Telemetry Stream Truncation & Causal Grid Imputation
